data.title: 神裂火织 · 厨房灶台前的七天七刀神速切菜
data.description: 厨房案板前，神裂火织全神贯注地展现出神入化的神速刀法将蔬菜切得整整齐齐。被你从身后搂住纤细腰肢时，圣人娇躯一颤，刀光骤停，脸颊通红地回头轻声嗔怪。
data.location: clean domestic kitchen with ingredients lined up on counter
data.action: slicing vegetables at lightning speed, partner hugs her midriff from behind, stopping knife and turning back with blushing cheeks and loving gaze
data.lighting: warm cheerful afternoon sunlight streaming onto kitchen counter
data.mood: charming warrior wife domesticity, sweet close proximity, heart-throbbing romantic chemistry
data.promptProse: In a sunny kitchen slicing vegetables, Kaori Kanzaki blushes warmly as partner hugs her toned midriff from behind, turning with loving purple eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kaori Kanzaki blushing happily as partner hugs her waist while cooking.
